import sys, random, ctypes, itertools
sys.path.insert(0,'.'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor')
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
import numpy as np
from netnomos.finite import WindowSchema, WindowUniverse

rng=random.Random(3)
bad=0
for trial in range(300):
    nf=rng.randint(1,5); slots=rng.randint(1,4)
    if nf*slots>16: continue
    fields=[]
    for i in range(nf):
        d=sorted(rng.sample(range(0,30), rng.randint(1,4)))
        fields.append({'name':f'f{i}','type':rng.choice(['count','id','flag','size','time']),'domain':d})
    job={'fields':fields,'slots':slots,'predicates':[],'width':1,'train':[[[fields[0]['domain'][0]]*nf] for _ in range(1)],
         'approved':[],'queries':[]}
    schema=WindowSchema(job); uni=WindowUniverse(schema)
    # lexicographic check: universe rows must be sorted by position tuples
    pos=np.zeros((uni.size, uni.cells), dtype=np.int64)
    for c in range(uni.cells):
        dom=schema.field_domains[uni.cell_field[c]]
        pos[:,c]=np.searchsorted(np.array(dom), uni.matrix[:,c])
    order=np.lexsort(tuple(pos[:,c] for c in range(uni.cells-1,-1,-1)))
    if not np.array_equal(order, np.arange(uni.size)):
        bad+=1; print('ORDER MISMATCH', nf, slots, [f['domain'] for f in fields])
    # spot-check specific indices
    for _ in range(5):
        u=rng.randrange(uni.size)
        flat=list(uni.matrix[u])
        w=[flat[s*nf:(s+1)*nf] for s in range(slots)]
        if uni.index_of(w)!=u:
            bad+=1; print('INDEX MISMATCH', w, uni.index_of(w), u)
    # first row = all smallest, last = all largest
    if not all(uni.matrix[0,c]==schema.field_domains[uni.cell_field[c]][0] for c in range(uni.cells)):
        bad+=1; print('FIRST ROW BAD')
    if not all(uni.matrix[-1,c]==schema.field_domains[uni.cell_field[c]][-1] for c in range(uni.cells)):
        bad+=1; print('LAST ROW BAD')
print('universe ordering problems:', bad)
EOF
